name: trinoris-secure
description: Workspace root for @trinoris/securegit, @trinoris/securelib, @trinoris/securelib-piv, and @trinoris/securelib-fido2. Not published — see packages/* for the real packages.

scripts.build: npm run build:securelib && npm run build --workspace=packages/securegit && npm run build:securelib-piv && npm run build:securelib-fido2
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:securelib && npm run build:securelib-piv && npm run build:securelib-fido2 && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build:securelib && npm run build:securelib-piv && npm run build:securelib-fido2 && npm run test --workspaces
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:securelib && npm run test:integration --workspace=packages/securegit
scripts.chaos:sandbox: docker compose -f chaos/docker-compose.yml up --build -d && docker compose -f chaos/docker-compose.yml wait verifier; docker compose -f chaos/docker-compose.yml logs verifier; docker compose -f chaos/docker-compose.yml down -v

author: TRINORIS
